name: Memento Mori Staff
text:
A carved nosoi figurine sits atop this white ash staff, which carries the faint scent of funereal herbs. These staves are often used by Pharasmins to communicate with the unquiet dead and lay them to rest. A memento mori staff is a +2 striking astral staff.

Activate—Pierce the Veil 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

---
Effect The staff searches for undead, warming to your touch if there are any undead within 60 feet. It cannot identify the precise location of the undead, nor their exact numbers. You can Sustain this effect for a maximum of 1 minute.

---
Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
- CantripVitality Lash

- 1st Bless, Infuse Vitality

- 2nd Palm-Held Sun, Spirit Sense

- 3rd Anointed Ground, Reblooded

- 4th Ghostly Tragedy, Talking Corpse

- 5th Infuse Vitality, Peaceful Rest

---
Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
